overview: Trade items with another player without the risk of a drop-and-grab. Both sides watch the offer build, and nothing changes hands until both accept.

1.2.0: A trade offer arrives in the notice tray, with Accept and Decline on it.
Chat only ever carried one [Accept], so turning an offer down meant ignoring it.
Saying no is an answer now, and the person who asked is told so.
1.1.1: A trade is no longer turned down for want of room when part-full stacks would have taken it.
1.1.0: A trade only starts when both games can actually draw the screen.
Accepting names whose request you are answering. Redrawn icon.
1.0.0: Shift-right-click a player to offer a trade, and a synced screen shows each side's offer.
Items are held in escrow and come back if somebody disconnects.
An operator can push a one-sided server offer at a player through the same screen.
